column3: (Re-examine Cache-control Directives -- most routes are auth-gated dynamic pages already sent no-store by Next.js; revisit if static asset caching changes)
(Content-Type Header Missing -- the three hits are all 307 redirects out of middleware, which carry no body to type; every 200 response is typed)
(Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments -- prototype source comments reference section numbers from the spec, not secrets; reviewed manually)
(Non-Storable Content -- restates the no-store above from the other direction: auth-gated pages are deliberately not cacheable)

(CSP: script-src unsafe-eval -- a scan-environment artifact, not a property of the app. next.config.ts adds unsafe-eval only when NODE_ENV is not production, and the DAST job runs NODE_ENV=test so ZAP has dev sign-in; the shipped production CSP has no unsafe-eval)
(Base64 Disclosure -- matches Next.js build IDs and inline flight data, not encoded secrets; spot-checked against the reported evidence)
(Session Management Response Identified -- informational: ZAP noting the Auth.js session cookie exists, which is the intended design)

(Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy Header Missing -- COEP require-corp breaks the Entra ID sign-in flow's cross-origin assets and buys nothing here; the app is not cross-origin isolated by design and does not use SharedArrayBuffer)
(Sec-Fetch-Dest Header is Missing -- this is a check on the *request* headers ZAP itself sends, not on anything the app returns; browsers set it automatically)
